kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Band Rs 60-65, lot 225 (company announcement as reported; RHP prints [●]). At Rs 65: 9.604 crore post-issue shares, market cap Rs 624 cr; P/E 24.1x FY26 PAT (28.6x on adjusted Rs 21.83 cr); company's own P/E 16.9x (pre-issue weighted shares); P/B 2.24x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 10.6x FY26.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: CFO Rs 15.23 / 16.17 / 8.14 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 14.83 / 18.21 / 25.90 cr: cumulative CFO 67% of PAT. FY26 CFO fell as receivables rose by Rs 33.22 cr (Vedanta and HZL billing cycles); Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 1.44 cr on PAT Rs 3.02 cr. Working capital is lumpy and growth-led, not a material issue.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Hindustan Zinc 42.01% / 35.74% / 35.35% of revenue FY24-26 and 41.31% in Q1 FY27; the Vedanta group (HZL, Vedanta Ltd and its units) Rs 252.0 / 310.2 / 437.5 cr = 64.7% / 65.3% / 77.9% of revenue, 83.3% in Q1 FY27 (p. 190). Top 5 customers 79.30% FY26, 91.37% Q1; top 10 suppliers 60.70% of FY26 purchases. O&M contracts run 2-5 years (p. 27). Concentration is typical for an industrial O&M contractor but is high.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: Delays in depositing PF and ESIC, filing TDS returns and paying GST in each of FY24-Q1 FY27; GST payable rose to Rs 14.28 cr at Mar-25 partly from delayed payment due to liquidity (p. 120). All dues paid by the RHP date.

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: Independent director Madan Lal Kothari is named in a 2021 chargesheet (IPC 420/467/468/471/120-B) as an attesting witness to an allegedly forged will in a private family dispute (FIR 405/2018, Jaipur); pending trial. Not related to the company.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -27.4% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: RED: objects floor sits above blended fair value

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Contract terms with Hindustan Zinc and Vedanta (renewal dates, pricing, KPI deductions)

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Revenue phasing of the Rs 1,761.9 cr order book by year

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Bonus issues of 89,52,516 shares in Mar-2017 and 5,40,75,600 shares (6:1) on 26-May-2025 (pp. 102-103); EPS restated for the bonus in all years (p. 86). FY26 basic EPS Rs 3.84 on PAT Rs 25.90 cr = 6.745 crore weighted shares; pre-issue capital 6,90,41,200 shares (p. 101), on which FY26 EPS is Rs 3.75. Private placement of 59,53,000 shares at Rs 38 to 31 non-promoter investors on 2-Jul-2025 (Rs 22.62 cr, registered-valuer price, p. 103).

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 4.09 / 8.20 / 8.61 cr = 20% / 32% / 24% of PBT; tax paid in cash Rs 3.87 / 8.87 / 8.27 cr (p. 87).

comfort.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
comfort.detail: Related-party dealings are director pay (Rs 2.67 cr FY26), salaries of relatives and KMP, guest-house rent Rs 0.28 cr and equipment hire Rs 0.73 cr; no related-party capex, no loans to promoters outstanding, no funds into the UAE subsidiary from the issue.

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Fresh issue fixed at 2,70,00,000 shares; specific object Rs 120.00 cr incremental working capital (Rs 82.50 cr FY27, Rs 37.50 cr FY28). With expenses assumed at 8% the cap leaves GCP of about Rs 41.5 cr (23.6% of gross, cap 25%), so the objects need about Rs 65 a share: the cap and the objects floor coincide.

comfort.title: Revaluation reserve
comfort.detail: No revaluation of assets since incorporation.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 56.47 cr at Jun-26 (47.3% of net worth), of which Rs 30.01 cr bank guarantees and Rs 23.00 cr receivables financed by SBI under Vedanta's vendor-finance programme with recourse (p. 88). Tax proceedings against the company Rs 1.20 cr; no criminal or regulatory action against the company or promoters (p. 58).

comfort.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
comfort.detail: Statutory and peer-review auditor Keyur Shah & Associates; no qualification or emphasis of matter identified in the restated financial information.

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Reg 6(1): operating profit (PBT + finance cost - other income) Rs 25.84 / 32.43 / 40.97 cr FY24-26 (our computation), above the Rs 15 cr test; net worth positive each year.

Lever 2 - implied WACC at terminal g
Lever 4 - required NWC % of revenue (steady state)

overhang.label: Pre-issue non-promoter shareholders (Jul-2025 placement at Rs 38, 31 holders)
Promoters' minimum contribution (20% of post-issue capital)

strengths: Order book Rs 1,761.9 cr = 3.1x FY26 revenue (p. 189)
16-year relationship with Hindustan Zinc; 87-94% repeat-client revenue (pp. 27, 138)
Owned fleet of 232 cranes, hydras, trucks and excavators (p. 189)
weaknesses: Late PF, ESIC, TDS and GST payments in each period (pp. 35-36)
opportunities: New Vedanta Goa and Silvassa units (p. 441)
Outsourcing of maintenance in metals and cement; O&M market +6% a year (p. 168)
UAE work through Monomark Engineering FZE (p. 191)
threats: Non-renewal or re-pricing of a large Vedanta-group contract
Wage and labour-law cost inflation on a 6,800-person workforce
Recourse on Rs 23.0 cr of receivables financed by SBI for Vedanta (p. 88)

adjustments.item: Recurring actuarial losses on the gratuity plan, taken to OCI each year
adjustments.reason: Remeasurement losses on the defined-benefit (gratuity) plan of Rs 7.02 / 6.79 / 5.45 cr FY24-26 (and Rs 0.65 cr in Q1 FY27) go to other comprehensive income, not to profit (p. 86). For a contractor with 6,300-7,300 site employees, a loss in every year indicates that the service cost charged to profit understates the true cost of the obligation (attrition and wage assumptions). Total comprehensive income was Rs 21.84 cr in FY26 against PAT Rs 25.90 cr.

adjustments.item: Loss on sale of fixed assets (fleet disposals)
adjustments.reason: Losses on sale of PPE of Rs 1.42 / 1.07 / 2.04 cr reduced profit (p. 87). They recur each year with routine replacement of trucks, cranes and loaders, so they are part of the cost of running the fleet; shown so the test stays two-sided, kept out of the adjusted P/E.

adjustments.item: Interest on fixed deposits in other income
adjustments.reason: Interest received Rs 1.55 / 2.08 / 2.29 cr (p. 87), largely on deposits held as margin for bank guarantees that the O&M contracts require; small (6.5% of FY26 PBT) and linked to operations. For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported FY26 P/E of 24.1x is flattered by the items flagged: adjusted P/E 28.6x (PAT -15.7%). On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 31.8x reported and 42.0x adjusted.
